wayfarer_camp.title: Wayfarer's Rest
wayfarer_camp.description: A caravan camp spreads across the last firm ground before the Glass Flats. Canvas snaps in the wind, and the horizon throws back the sun in pieces.

glass_flats.title: The Glass Flats
glass_flats.description: A plain of fused sand stretches to the horizon. Dark stones mark the safe path, while the light between them shifts like water.

sunken_observatory.title: The Sunken Observatory
sunken_observatory.description: A half-buried dome of brass and black glass, its mirrors still turning to follow a sun that has not moved in years.
